mapper.sql: WITH current_discovery AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (discovery.platform_provider_connection_id, discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision) discovery.id FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery discovery JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection ON connection.id = discovery.platform_provider_connection_id WHERE connection.id = #{connectionId} AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.version = #{revision} AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision = #{revision} AND discovery.succeeded = TRUE AND discovery.expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY discovery.platform_provider_connection_id, discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision, discovery.discovered_at DESC, discovery.id DESC ), candidate_projection AS ( SELECT candidate.model_code, candidate.display_name, candidate.candidate_key, COALESCE(confirmation.model_type, candidate.model_type) AS model_type, CASE WHEN confirmation.discovery_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED_BY_ADMIN' ELSE candidate.classification END AS classification, COALESCE(array_to_string(confirmation.capabilities, ','), array_to_string(candidate.capabilities, ',')) AS capabilities FROM model_runtime.platform_discovered_model candidate JOIN current_discovery ON current_discovery.id = candidate.discovery_id LEFT JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_candidate_confirmation confirmation ON confirmation.discovery_id = candidate.discovery_id AND confirmation.model_code = candidate.model_code )

FROM candidate_projection WHERE concat_ws(' ', model_code, display_name, CASE WHEN classification = 'REQUIRES_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION' THEN '待管理员确认' WHEN model_type = 'CHAT' THEN '对话模型' WHEN model_type = 'EMBEDDING' THEN '向量模型' ELSE '待确认' END) ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select: SELECT model_code, model_type, capabilities, classification, display_name ORDER BY model_code ASC, candidate_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery (id, platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, succeeded, result_code, elapsed_millis, discovered_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{connectionId}, #{revision}, #{succeeded}, #{resultCode}, #{elapsedMillis}, #{discoveredAt}, #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_discovered_model (discovery_id, model_code, model_type, capabilities, classification, display_name) VALUES (#{discoveryId}, #{modelCode}, #{modelType}, string_to_array(#{capabilities}, ','), #{classification}, #{displayName})
